position_units.materialization_tables: native voxels of the 4x4x40 nm aligned volume
position_units.skeleton: precomputed skeleton coordinates are nanometres (identity transform in skeleton info)

limitations: One neuron from the MICrONS minnie65_public volume, which is a cubic-millimetre-scale column of mouse visual cortex, not a whole mouse brain.
Synapses come from the automated synapses_pni_2 detector; the proofread dendrite and axon compartments are considered accurate but possibly incomplete.
The cell type is a dataset classifier annotation (cell_type_multifeature_combo), not a manual ground-truth label.
The skeleton is the dataset's own reconstruction at materialization version 1926; it is not a new morphology model.
Partner root ids are valid at materialization version 1926; they are not comparable across versions without a mapping.
